item.text:
As of **22 November 2026**, use **OWASP ASVS 5.0.0** for a production checklist. OWASP’s downloads page labels it “Stable Release 5.0.0,” the project records its publication date as **30 May 2025**, and the GitHub release tag is `v5.0.0_release`. [OWASP downloads](https://asvs.owasp.org/downloads/) · [OWASP publication date](https://asvs.owasp.org/) · [Tagged 5.0.0 release](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/releases/tag/v5.0.0_release)

GitHub’s **“Latest”** badge belongs to the **Bleeding Edge** build, generated on **17 November 2026** from the `master` branch. Its release notes describe it as a testing and preview build and explicitly direct production users to **v5.0.0**. [OWASP release list](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/releases) · [Bleeding Edge release notes](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/releases/tag/latest)
